top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards a theory-and-nature pair: the Bistritzer-MacDonald prediction of magic-angle flat bands and the 2018 observation of correlated insulators and superconductivity, since reproduced by many groups and extended to other moire platforms. It opened a new tunable class of matter rather than refining an existing measurement. The citation is confined to the prediction and observed phenomena, leaving the unresolved pairing mechanism unclaimed. The credit gap around Yuan Cao is a real cost, but P001 is a fully defensible second choice with a clean two-name attribution and a reproduced 1e-18 result. Both clearly beat making no award.
